statusDefinitions.fixed_local: source is repaired and an executable local regression or source contract exists; deployment and new browser paths require CI
statusDefinitions.open: confirmed or explicitly material finding with no comprehensive verified fix
statusDefinitions.unverified: credible risk lacking the required interaction, platform, screenshot, or backend evidence
statusDefinitions.environment_blocked: required gate was attempted but environmental precondition did not permit a verdict

issues.expected: The authored invocation reads one supplied stdin line, preserves whitespace in raw text and distinguishes valid, whitespace-only and EOF behavior
issues.observed: Old Python/REPL paste was interpreted as a noninteractive Python script and could throw EOFError; a bulk-pasted shell recipe was not runnable as shown
issues.rootCause: Confused an interactive terminal experiment with a static audited Python example
issues.attack: Run the exact published command through bash with `input=' 34 \n'`, `input='   \n'` and empty stdin
issues.defense: Input is by definition interactive, so learners can type when prompted
issues.judgment: CONFIRMED_FINDING: displayed command and automated content runner must have distinct execution contracts
issues.fix: Publish executable Bash/Zsh single-quoted python3 -c command, Windows REPL alternative, dedicated stdin/EOF regression, mark block bash
issues.negativeControl: Original version failed real invocation and/or strict audit; authored-command regression now checks three concrete inputs
issues.spread: Any I/O lesson containing real input(), piped stdin or shell transcript

issues.element: T3-B Decimal instruction and S02-decimal-rounding figure
issues.expected: Currency amounts use Decimal constructed from text, and round/quantize at contractually defined monetary boundaries
issues.observed: Earlier figure instructed exactly one round at the end, even where separate tax/tip line items require independently rounded amounts
issues.rootCause: A pedagogical shortcut was incorrectly elevated to a universal accounting rule
issues.attack: For amount 0.05 and tax 10% with ROUND_HALF_EVEN, rounding tax line then adding yields 0.05 but rounding only grand total yields 0.06
issues.defense: Delaying rounding can reduce accumulated rounding error
issues.judgment: CONFIRMED_FINDING: correctness depends on the required accounting boundary; no universal once-at-end formula
issues.fix: Describe quantization boundaries explicitly in prose and figure and assert exact two-decimal exponent in money exercises
issues.negativeControl: Independent 0.05-vs-0.06 decimal counterexample and unquantized-solution mutation rejected
issues.spread: All finance, pricing, IGV and statistical rounding lessons

issues.expected: Identity-vs-equality illustration distinguishes None, False, numeric zero, empty string and other values
issues.observed: Boolean false and numeric zero merged as one equality branch; the visual failed to preserve identity distinction
issues.rootCause: Truthiness and equality were conflated in a decision-style SVG
issues.attack: Use False and 0: `False == 0` is True while `False is 0` is False; route False before numeric-zero equality
issues.defense: Both values are falsy in a conditional
issues.judgment: CONFIRMED_FINDING: falsiness is not the same as semantic identity
issues.fix: Separate ordered False and 0 branches; update alt, diagram height and captions
issues.negativeControl: Source oracle fails when False branch disappears or follows zero
issues.spread: Truthy/falsy diagrams, filtering, missing-value policy in data analysis

issues.element: T1–T4 formative topic evaluations and You Do task
issues.expected: S02 assessment asks only for values, type inspection, assignment, operators, Decimal and basic I/O already demonstrated
issues.observed: Original assessment required safe_int, make_record, parse_client, dictionary errors, def, try/except and invalid-value recovery taught in later sections
issues.rootCause: The final parser project was assigned before its prerequisites, blending a vertical project milestone with S02 competence
issues.attack: Complete S02 directly after S01 without S03 decisions, S05 functions, S06 dict or S09 exception handling
issues.judgment: CONFIRMED_FINDING: an in-scope scored task must not depend on material explicitly deferred
issues.fix: Rewrote topic evaluations as separable, reproducible S02-sized tasks; preserve raw/clean/value project and observe errors in independent runs
issues.negativeControl: Tests reject untaught function/condition/exception/parser phrases in evaluated blocks
issues.spread: All 52 sections' assessments and first-use prerequisite graph

issues.element: All 24 S02 We Do cards, exercise interaction
issues.expected: Learner can edit and run each authored Python starter in-place with transparent, distinct exception and stdout states
issues.observed: On deployed page there was Copy and solution reveal but no per-exercise editor, and completion was possible without an attempt
issues.rootCause: Shared We Do renderer was a static worksheet scaffold, not an executable card
issues.attack: Edit Python that raises ValueError, run, correct to a print, run, close and reopen; compare error and stdout
issues.defense: Terminal-first self-directed practice is valid when clearly labeled
issues.judgment: CONFIRMED_FINDING for absent on-page execution; grading/completion is still deliberately unverified
issues.fix: S02-only lazy Python editor for each starter; label it ungraded; preserve other sections' shell/Markdown semantics
issues.negativeControl: New browser spec asserts exception text and distinct valid stdout, but local Chromium install is blocked; test has not run
issues.spread: Future opt-in sections after runtime/content audit
issues.tradeoff: Pyodide network dependency and client-side startup cost; no automatic scoring

issues.expected: Tab and Shift+Tab leave the multiline editor, making later buttons and prior controls keyboard reachable
issues.observed: Shared CodePlayground caught every Tab and Shift+Tab and inserted spaces, trapping keyboard-only focus
issues.rootCause: Code indentation shortcut intercepted standard navigation without an escape mechanism
issues.attack: Focus Python textarea and press Tab and Shift+Tab with unchanged source
issues.defense: Tab is standard for indentation in programming editors
issues.judgment: CONFIRMED_FINDING: WCAG 2.1.2 demands an escapable keyboard trap
issues.fix: Remove Tab interception; native focus movement with explicit instructions to use spaces for indentation
issues.negativeControl: Falsifiable browser assertions authored for both focus exits and source nonmutation; browser execution pending
issues.tradeoff: Typing Tab no longer auto-inserts four spaces

issues.element: Unfinished draft across We Do → Theory → We Do
issues.expected: Closing an editor or changing lesson stage leaves its in-progress code recoverable until component unmount or reset
issues.observed: QA reviewer traced draft local state through keyed motion.div; changing tab unmounted WeDoTab and silently restored starter on return
issues.rootCause: Per-card state lived below a keyed animation boundary
issues.attack: Edit E1 then navigate to Theory, return to We Do, reopen E1; ensure edited value survives, then Reset reverts to authored starter
issues.defense: An exercise restart could intentionally reset a worksheet
issues.judgment: CONFIRMED_FINDING: unlabeled silent loss is undesirable and conflicts with resume expectations
issues.fix: SectionView-scoped immutable React draft state keyed section and exercise ID; share through WeDoTab/ExerciseEditor
issues.negativeControl: A browser test asserts precise tab-unmount regression; local browser run pending
issues.spread: Shared tab panel lifecycle and future interactive widgets
issues.tradeoff: Drafts are intentionally not stored across full reloads, preventing inadvertent persistence of learner code; updating parent state on each keystroke can incur a render cost

issues.expected: S02 introduces the concept as vocabulary before S04–S05 self-checks use it; S06 later teaches operations
issues.observed: Moving Dict to collections caused introductory glossary check and S04/S05 self-check vocabulary tests to fail
issues.rootCause: Glossary metadata models first mention, not the section of comprehensive teaching
issues.attack: Run first-use and self-check vocabulary gates after delaying Dict to S06
issues.defense: S06 is the collection's primary teaching module
issues.judgment: REJECTED_FINDING for globally deferring its first mention; retained an early plain-language definition instead
issues.fix: Restore firstSectionId basics and explicitly teach dict as a mapping vocabulary preview without assigning construction in S02
issues.negativeControl: Cross-course gate failed on S06 metadata; S02 source definition oracle added
issues.verification: npm run test:ux-gates; npm run test:adversarial:node; tests/adversarial/test_s02_independent_contract.py

issues.expected: Clearly self-reported completion or independent evidence of correct execution and mastery
issues.observed: Clicking deployed 'Práctica completada' with no work marked it Completado; the newly added editor explicitly does not grade learner code
issues.rootCause: Progress records a stage acknowledgment, not 24 independently passed exercise contracts
issues.attack: Paste unrelated print('OK'), or do nothing, then mark complete; the UI still reports completion
issues.defense: Guided practice is a legitimate self-reflection stage and not every exercise needs machine grading
issues.judgment: CONFIRMED_FINDING in interpretation; no false claim of verified mastery is permissible
issues.fix: Product-level decision: rename as self-reported practice/read or introduce per-exercise assessed correctness and evidentiary completion distinct from viewing
issues.negativeControl: Live empty-attempt click accepted; no backend grading was observed
issues.spread: All 1248 We Do cards, certificates and progress interpretation

issues.expected: Concurrent/aborted exercise executions never cross-wire stdout, stderr or stale results between two editors
issues.observed: Source uses a global Pyodide promise and shared stdout/stderr callbacks, but no verified crossed output was captured
issues.rootCause: Potential global runtime state without a per-run ownership guard
issues.attack: Begin delayed output in E1, close it, run E2 while E1 is pending, assert output ownership and recovery
issues.defense: Pyodide execution may serialize synchronously; no reproduced race yet
issues.judgment: UNRESOLVED; hypothesis not counted as bug
issues.fix: Instrument run IDs/serialized queue or isolated workers if a falsifiable browser race reproduces

issues.element: Desktop floating HUD, sidebar, quiz ring, 320px reflow and 400% zoom
issues.expected: Correct reading order and focus with no content hidden under sticky and floating controls, including animations and reduced motion
issues.observed: 1363x936 deployed view shows 285px side rail and floating controls near the bottom of the viewport; observed document exceeds 29,000px; narrow viewport and keyboard/reduced-motion matrix not completed
issues.rootCause: Extremely long card stack and fixed overlay architecture increase spatial and navigation risk
issues.attack: At 320px/400% zoom, expand an E24 solution near footer, focus last control, inspect clipped text and scroll restoration
issues.defense: Desktop controls occupy margin and mobile CSS may replace rails
issues.judgment: UNRESOLVED; no categorical occlusion defect claimed without captures
issues.fix: CI screenshot/reflow/focus matrix and responsive layout repair driven by actual failures
issues.verification: Live CUA desktop viewport; Playwright CI pending
issues.spread: Every 52-section tab, global HUD, bottom nav and code cards

issues.element: Exact-SHA end-to-end and strict Python package execution
issues.expected: Pinned .venv-content, Chromium E2E, 24 exercises, 11 quiz options, all-page screen-reader/motion tests and post-deployment parity complete on identical source SHA
issues.observed: No pinned .venv-content in local environment; system NumPy/pandas version drift causes strict content auditor refusal; Chromium download returned zero-byte invalid ZIP
issues.rootCause: Required environment artifacts unavailable, not an application pass/fail verdict
issues.attack: Run `npm run test:python-strict` and install Playwright Chromium then run the shard
issues.defense: Static/unit source gates and source-review can independently catch many defects
issues.judgment: UNRESOLVED release blocker: a substitute is not an equivalent test
issues.fix: Let GitHub Actions acquire the pinned Python/browser dependencies, inspect traces and verify deployed SHA; fix any resulting product failures

issues.element: GitHub Actions pull_request branch filter for stacked audit
issues.expected: Opening PR #120 against the existing S01 draft branch schedules the S02 Chromium regression suite
issues.observed: No runs appeared after creating PR #120 because workflow pull_request branches were restricted to main and curriculum/55
issues.rootCause: CI's branch filter assumed a direct-to-main PR, while the dependency-aware review used stacked PRs
issues.attack: Compare PR base audit/s01-forensic-qa-20261101 against workflow trigger and query workflow runs for its head SHA
issues.defense: Most production PRs eventually target main, so final CI could run after retargeting
issues.judgment: CONFIRMED_FINDING: no CI on the review SHA weakens the current release decision
issues.fix: Add the exact S01 parent branch to pull_request filter; assert trigger and spec in an independent source test
issues.negativeControl: Original workflow omitted the branch, and GitHub returned workflow_runs:[]; new trigger asserted before rerun
issues.spread: All future stacked review branches; this change intentionally only allows the current audited stack
issues.tradeoff: A narrow temporary review-branch trigger requires maintenance when the stack base is retired
